+
+Recovered finite common-carrier proof design from retained conversation context.
+This file is not production source and is not a compiler/replay/audit log.
+The four candidate declarations and the two usage examples have not been compiled.
+They are not included in the existing five-module, 53-theorem source inventory.
+
+The import and namespace mirror UpperCoefficientPerturbation.lean.
+When inserting into that file, copy only the declarations/examples into its
+existing namespace. No analytic assembly theorem is added here.
+-/
+
+import ImbalancedChen.ActualSmallRoughAttachment
+
+namespace ImbalancedChen
+
+noncomputable section
+
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+theorem smallRoughRho_eq_of_rough_subset
+    (small Rraw R : Finset ℕ)
+    (raw betaMinus betaPlus : ℕ → ℝ)
+    (hsub : Rraw ⊆ R)
+    (hzero : ∀ d ∈ R, d ∉ Rraw → raw d = 0) :
+    smallRoughRho small R raw betaMinus betaPlus =
+      smallRoughRho small Rraw raw betaMinus betaPlus := by
+  classical
+  funext q
+  simp only [smallRoughRho, Finset.sum_filter, smallRoughPairs, Finset.sum_product]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro a _ha
+  symm
+  apply Finset.sum_subset hsub
+  intro d hd hdRaw
+  simp [smallRoughPairCoefficient, signAttachedCoefficient, hzero d hd hdRaw]
+
+theorem sum_smallRoughRho_mul_eq_of_rough_subset
+    (small Rraw R : Finset ℕ)
+    (raw betaMinus betaPlus F : ℕ → ℝ)
+    (hsub : Rraw ⊆ R)
+    (hzero : ∀ d ∈ R, d ∉ Rraw → raw d = 0) :
+    (∑ q ∈ smallRoughModuli small R,
+      smallRoughRho small R raw betaMinus betaPlus q * F q) =
+    ∑ q ∈ smallRoughModuli small Rraw,
+      smallRoughRho small Rraw raw betaMinus betaPlus q * F q := by
+  classical
+  have hmod :
+      smallRoughModuli small Rraw ⊆ smallRoughModuli small R := by
+    intro q hq
+    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hq with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
+    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩
+    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
+      ⟨(Finset.mem_product.mp hx).1, hsub ((Finset.mem_product.mp hx).2)⟩
+  rw [smallRoughRho_eq_of_rough_subset
+    small Rraw R raw betaMinus betaPlus hsub hzero]
+  symm
+  apply Finset.sum_subset hmod
+  intro q _hq hqRaw
+  simp only [smallRoughRho_eq_zero_of_not_mem
+    small Rraw raw betaMinus betaPlus hqRaw, zero_mul]
+
+theorem actualSmallRoughRho_eq_rough_union
+    (retainOdd : List ℕ → Bool) (N cap : ℕ) (w z L : ℝ)
+    (extra : Finset ℕ) :
+    smallRoughRho (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
+      (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z ∪ extra)
+      (fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z)
+      (actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L) (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L) =
+    actualSmallRoughRho retainOdd N cap w z L := by
+  unfold actualSmallRoughRho
+  apply smallRoughRho_eq_of_rough_subset
+  · exact Finset.subset_union_left
+  · intro d _hd hnot
+    change (oddFirstExitRetainedCoefficient retainOdd (fun _ => 1)
+      (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) d : ℝ) = 0
+    exact_mod_cast
+      (oddFirstExitRetainedCoefficient_eq_zero_of_not_mem
+        retainOdd (fun _ => 1) (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) d hnot)
+
+theorem supportedDivisorSum_eq_of_subset
+    (Rraw R : Finset ℕ) (raw : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
+    (hsub : Rraw ⊆ R)
+    (hzero : ∀ d ∈ R, d ∉ Rraw → raw d = 0) :
+    supportedDivisorSum R raw n = supportedDivisorSum Rraw raw n := by
+  classical
+  simp only [supportedDivisorSum, Finset.sum_filter]
+  symm
+  apply Finset.sum_subset hsub
+  intro d hd hdRaw
+  simp [hzero d hd hdRaw]
+

+        (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z ∪ extra))
+      (smallRoughRho (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
+        (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z ∪ extra)
+        (fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z)
+        (actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L) (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L)) =
+    physicalDensitySum (actualSmallRoughModuli retainOdd N cap w z)
+      (actualSmallRoughRho retainOdd N cap w z L) := by
+  have hzero : ∀ d ∈ fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z ∪ extra,
+      d ∉ fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z →
+        fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z d = 0 := by
+    intro d _hd hnot
+    change (oddFirstExitRetainedCoefficient retainOdd (fun _ => 1)
+      (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) d : ℝ) = 0
+    exact_mod_cast
+      (oddFirstExitRetainedCoefficient_eq_zero_of_not_mem
+        retainOdd (fun _ => 1) (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) d hnot)
+  unfold actualSmallRoughModuli actualSmallRoughRho
+  simpa only [physicalDensitySum, div_eq_mul_inv] using
+    (sum_smallRoughRho_mul_eq_of_rough_subset
+      (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
+      (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z)
+      (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z ∪ extra)
+      (fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z)
+      (actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L) (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L)
+      (fun q => (Nat.totient q : ℝ)⁻¹)
+      Finset.subset_union_left hzero)

+  have hzero : ∀ d ∈ fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z ∪ extra,
+      d ∉ fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z →
+        fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z d = 0 := by
+    intro d _hd hnot
+    change (oddFirstExitRetainedCoefficient retainOdd (fun _ => 1)
+      (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) d : ℝ) = 0
+    exact_mod_cast
+      (oddFirstExitRetainedCoefficient_eq_zero_of_not_mem
+        retainOdd (fun _ => 1) (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) d hnot)
+  rw [supportedDivisorSum_eq_of_subset
+    (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z)
+    (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z ∪ extra)
+    (fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z) n.natAbs
+    Finset.subset_union_left hzero]
+  exact roughIndicator_le_fixedRoughDivisorSum retainOdd N cap w z hzcap n

+end

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Read-only Part 4 source-type extraction, not compiler verification.
+
+Usage from the repository root:
+  python verification/parts/p4a/round2/extract_source_types.py --repo .
+  python verification/parts/p4a/round2/extract_source_types.py --repo . \
+    --check-json verification/parts/p4a/round2/SOURCE_TYPES.json
+
+Without --check-json, JSON is printed to stdout. This script writes no files,
+does not require .git, and never runs Lean, a build, replay, or an axiom audit.
+It extracts theorem signatures ending in ':= by' from the five known modules.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+
+STATUS = "SOURCE_EXTRACTED_NOT_COMPILER_INVENTORY"
+MODULES = (
+    "ActualUpperPolicyDensity",
+    "UpperCoefficientPerturbation",
+    "ActualUpperDensityAssembly",
+    "RealPhysicalUpperWeightBridge",
+    "RealUpperCountingAssembly",
+)
+DECLARATION = re.compile(
+    r"(?m)^(?:@\[[^\n]*?\] )?theorem ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\b"
+)
+PROOF_DELIMITER = re.compile(r"\s:= by(?:\s|$)")
+
+
+def extract_module(repo: Path, module: str) -> dict:
+    relative = f"ImbalancedChen/{module}.lean"
+    source_bytes = (repo / relative).read_bytes()
+    source = source_bytes.decode("utf-8")
+    declarations = []
+    for match in DECLARATION.finditer(source):
+        tail = source[match.start():]
+        delimiter = PROOF_DELIMITER.search(tail)
+        if delimiter is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"No ':= by' delimiter: {module}.{match.group(1)}")
+        signature = tail[:delimiter.start()].rstrip()
+        if len(list(DECLARATION.finditer(signature))) != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unexpected declaration boundary: {module}.{match.group(1)}")
+        name = match.group(1)
+        full_name = f"ImbalancedChen.{name}"
+        declarations.append(
+            {
+                "name": name,
+                "full_name": full_name,
+                "signature": signature,
+                "qualified_signature": signature.replace(
+                    "theorem " + name, "theorem " + full_name, 1
+                ),
+            }
+        )
+    blob_header = b"blob " + str(len(source_bytes)).encode("ascii") + b"\0"
+    return {
+        "module": f"ImbalancedChen.{module}",
+        "path": relative,
+        "imports": [line for line in source.splitlines() if line.startswith("import ")],
+        "public_theorem_count": len(declarations),
+        "declarations": declarations,
+        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        "git_blob_sha1": hashlib.sha1(blob_header + source_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        "source_bytes": len(source_bytes),
+    }
+
+
+def verify_saved_inventory(current: dict, saved: dict) -> None:
+    if saved.get("status") != STATUS:
+        raise ValueError("Saved file is not explicitly a source-only inventory")
+    current_files = {item["path"]: item for item in current["files"]}
+    saved_files = {item["path"]: item for item in saved["files"]}
+    if current_files.keys() != saved_files.keys():
+        raise ValueError("Module set differs")
+    if current["public_theorem_count"] != saved.get("public_theorem_count"):
+        raise ValueError("Public theorem count differs")
+    for path, item in current_files.items():
+        previous = saved_files[path]
+        for field in ("sha256", "git_blob_sha1", "public_theorem_count"):
+            if item[field] != previous.get(field):
+                raise ValueError(f"{path}: {field} differs")
+        if item["declarations"] != previous["declarations"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"{path}: original or qualified signatures differ")
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, default=Path("."))
+    parser.add_argument("--expected-count", type=int, default=53)
+    parser.add_argument("--check-json", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    repo = args.repo.resolve()
+    files = [extract_module(repo, module) for module in MODULES]
+    total = sum(item["public_theorem_count"] for item in files)
+    if total != args.expected_count:
+        raise ValueError(f"Expected {args.expected_count} declarations; found {total}")
+    data = {
+        "status": STATUS,
+        "extracted_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "namespace": "ImbalancedChen",
+        "proofs_included": False,
+        "full_source_hashes_included": True,
+        "public_theorem_count": total,
+        "verification_note": "Source-text extraction only; no compiler verification.",
+        "qualification_note": (
+            "signature preserves the source text. qualified_signature only qualifies "
+            "the declared theorem name; all other identifiers retain their original "
+            "ImbalancedChen namespace context. This is not compiler elaboration."
+        ),
+        "files": files,
+    }
+    if args.check_json is not None:
+        path = args.check_json
+        if not path.is_absolute():
+            path = repo / path
+        verify_saved_inventory(data, json.loads(path.read_text()))
+        print(json.dumps({
+            "status": STATUS,
+            "modules": len(files),
+            "public_theorems": total,
+            "original_signatures_match": True,
+            "qualified_signatures_match": True,
+            "source_hashes_match": True,
+            "compiler_run": False,
+        }, ensure_ascii=False))
+    else:
+        print(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
+
